title: A-Level Computer Science (9618) Max pack
blurb: Algorithm clarity, precise terminology, and paper technique for theory + practical-style reasoning.
examinerDigest: Use the exact technical term the scheme expects — near-synonyms often miss the mark.
Show algorithm steps clearly; pseudocode structure earns method marks even when syntax slips.
Trace tables need every column filled for the rows the question asks — don't skip.
Link explanations to the named concept in the syllabus, not a vague description.
